children: Online vehicle auction firm's fiscal Q4 revenue rose 2.4%, slightly beating analyst expectations
International revenue jumps to $222.1 million from $198.8 million, outpacing U.S. growth
EPS for fiscal Q4 declined and missed analyst expectations
Net income and gross profit both fell yr/yr, impacted by higher operating expenses
Copart did not provide specific guidance or outlook for the current or upcoming periods
VEHICLE SALES GROWTH - Revenue rose 2.4% as vehicle sales increased 8.3% to $182.9 mln and service revenue rose 1.4% to $969.5 mln
FACILITY COST INFLATION - Gross profit fell 5.5% as facility operations costs rose 7.7%, vehicle-sale costs increased 11.4% and facility depreciation rose 14.0%
LOWER OTHER INCOME - Net income declined 17.4% as other income fell 45.6%, reflecting a 20.5% drop in net interest income and a swing in other income
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 9 "strong buy" or "buy", 5 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the online services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Copart Inc is $42.55, about 32.8% above its September 9 closing price of $32.03
The stock recently traded at 19 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 20 three months ago
